strategies.name: Opponent-adjusted scoring
strategies.design: Estimate recency-weighted offense/defense strength with shrinkage toward a league baseline; integrate a joint score distribution for moneyline/spread/total.
strategies.inputs: Prior official game scores, opponent IDs, home/neutral venue and input availability timestamps.
strategies.falsification: Compare with historical-mean and simultaneous no-vig market baselines; ablate opponent adjustment and recency separately.

strategies.name: Availability adjustment
strategies.design: Treat documented availability as a scenario mixture, not a guaranteed starter; estimate incremental predictive value relative to S01.
strategies.inputs: Official injury report snapshots, inactive lists and time-stamped lineup changes; no post-kickoff information.
strategies.falsification: Ablate availability effects; check missing-status sensitivity and probability calibration.

strategies.name: Schedule and rest
strategies.design: Test rest days, travel/venue and schedule changes only after obtaining official kickoffs and venue records.
strategies.inputs: Official schedule history and revisions; travel distances and weather values stay blank until independently sourced.
strategies.falsification: Register features before selection; use rolling week/season folds and pooled-versus-team effects.

strategies.name: Volume × efficiency
strategies.design: Model attempts/targets/participation and conditional efficiency jointly with overdispersion; integrate the entire stat distribution at each quoted line.
strategies.inputs: Official player game logs, participation evidence and exact operator prop definitions with odds.
strategies.falsification: Compare to player rolling baseline; ablate volume and efficiency; evaluate tails and zero participation.

strategies.name: Role-change scenario
strategies.design: Test whether officially documented roster/availability changes improve conditional opportunity forecasts beyond a pooled player baseline.
strategies.inputs: Time-stamped official team/league role evidence; no inferred promotions or injury severity.
strategies.falsification: Separate documented information from model assumptions; sensitivity to usage uncertainty; hold out affected games.

strategies.name: Joint outcome calibration
strategies.design: Use a predeclared two-leg universe and paired contemporaneous forecast errors; estimate joint probability rather than silently multiplying legs.
strategies.inputs: Aligned dated outcomes and simultaneous actual combo payouts; common-week clustering.
strategies.falsification: Test dependence across weeks/seasons and compare joint forecast with independence benchmark; validate offered combo prices.

strategies.name: Quarterback + receiver
strategies.design: Jointly model team passing volume, receiver target allocation, catches and yards under shared game scenarios. No assumed positive correlation coefficient.
strategies.inputs: Paired official player-game outcomes; quote line/payout/void-rule snapshots for the precise combination.
strategies.falsification: Estimate binary outcome phi for exact thresholds and joint win rate; validate full distribution out of sample.

strategies.name: Game script + player usage
strategies.design: Test shared score/possession scenarios for side/total and rushing/receiving legs; dependence sign must be measured, not asserted.
strategies.inputs: Official game/player outcomes and exact thresholds plus executable operator combo quotes.
strategies.falsification: Shared-scenario simulation must honor marginal calibration and logical constraints; model 3+ legs directly.

flags.finding: A checked URL or passing unit test does not prove a strategy claim. Official maintainers document statistical tools; NFL does not endorse Own9 models.

flags.resolution: No fake fallback data, no credentials requested, no automatic wagering. The runner executes without inputs; it does not acquire feeds or schedule itself. Root publishing and workflow configuration belong to the integration owner.

flags.finding: Several sessions claimed overlapping scopes from the same initial checkout; later main updates and published boards exposed the overlap.
flags.resolution: Preserved main and prior logs; relocated this session entirely into strict-lab/. Root-site and CI navigation changes are requests to the active owners, not unauthorized edits.
